python3 -B /workspace/independent_checks.py 3: exact determinant reduction by both cyclotomic relations; checked the 652,544 normalized selections of the stated bounded cases plus 303,104 for C8 and C4×C2 at p=3,5; all nonsingular.
correctness.rationale: Cyclotomic irreducibility over Q(zeta_(2^r)) follows from the product cyclotomic degree for coprime conductors. Hence a zero determinant gives equal grouped coefficients. Reducing at a prime above two makes all dyadic phases and permutation signs equal to one; with six terms and odd p the common parity must be zero. In the normalized exponent lists {1+ts,s,t} and {s+t,ts,1}, neither s nor t occurs in the second list. If s differs from t, the remaining single exponent of the first list cannot give both even multiplicity. If s=t, remove the two copies of t; 1+t^2 differs from 2t, t^2 and 1. The argument includes p=3 and uses no principal selection assumption. Direct rank geometry gives a separate proof: for any row pair, the three componentwise ratios are distinct, since the quotient between two ratios has a nontrivial prime-order factor and a dyadic factor. Any linear combination with both coefficients nonzero can have unit modulus in at most two of those distinct ratios (intersection of a line with the unit circle), so a third unit-modulus row in the span would have to be proportional to one of the first two, which the same ratio test excludes.
residual_risks: Finite tests are consistency checks; the proof, not enumeration, covers arbitrary abelian dyadic groups and primes.

originality.rationale: The broader Resultary rank-two coset theorem gives the entire claim as an immediate corollary, not only the previously classified C2 case. Every two distinct rows are nonproportional on these columns: the quotient of their entry ratios between two columns is the product of a dyadic root and a nontrivial p-th root. The dual argument prevents proportional columns. Both coset counts are therefore three, so the broader theorem forces rank three. The displayed date of that broader record is later; this is verified coverage, not a determination of earlier publication priority.
residual_risks: Earlier exact general-H historical priority was not resolved; Caragea et al. announce a possible follow-up on orders with square divisors. The broader inspected catalogue record has a later displayed date than the frozen record.
